LanguageData.LW_WaitingForWorld: Living World is waiting for a RimWorld world to load.

LanguageData.LW_EmptyLedgerHint: The Living World ledger is empty. Retry bootstrap if the world has settlements, or create a visible test ledger to verify the mod pipeline.
LanguageData.LW_BootstrapErrorHint: Living World caught a bootstrap error instead of crashing the window: {error}
LanguageData.LW_BootstrapRetried: Bootstrap retried. Check the diagnostic line and settlement list.
LanguageData.LW_RaidHookStatus: Enemy vanilla raids use Living World: an intel or trade opportunity is required first, then adult citizens are reserved from faction settlements and raid strength is capped by available people.
LanguageData.LW_AllianceFormed: Allied with {faction}. Your attacks on their enemies now earn their gratitude.
LanguageData.LW_AllianceFailed: Could not ally with {faction} right now.
LanguageData.LW_AllianceObjectiveLetterText: {ally} asks you to strike {enemy}. Defeat {enemy}'s settlements to earn {ally}'s favour and help win the war.
LanguageData.LW_PlayerVictoryLetterText: {ally} has won the war against {enemy}, and you share in the victory. Your standing with {ally} rises.
LanguageData.LW_ListLimited: Showing {shown} of {total}. The full ledger is kept in memory and save data.
LanguageData.LW_KnowledgeLine: Known info: source {source} | confidence {confidence} | age {ageDays} days | stale {stale} | population {populationBand} | food {food} | migration {migration} | production {production}
LanguageData.LW_ProductionLine: Production: workers {workers} | food/day {food} | steel/day {steel} | medicine/day {medicine} | components/day {components} | biome {biome} | hills {hilliness} | tech {tech}
LanguageData.LW_ProductionHiddenLine: Exact production is unknown. Get fresher intel or visit the settlement map.
LanguageData.LW_ArmyLine: {name} [{faction}] | Alive {citizens} | Dead {deadCitizens} | Returned {returnedCitizens} | Captured {prisonerCitizens} | Meals {meals} | Steel {steel}
LanguageData.LW_WorldWarDisabledByRimWar: Rim War is driving world factions; Living World's world war is paused.
LanguageData.LW_WorldWarLetterText: The world's factions are at war. {captures} settlement(s) have changed hands since the last report.
LanguageData.LW_ConflictLetterText: Word arrives that {factionA} and {factionB} have gone to war. New conflicts this period: {count}.
LanguageData.LW_EmpireActiveNote: Empire manages your own empire; Living World tracks the NPC world's factions.
LanguageData.LW_InspectPopulationMissingLine: Living World population: no data for this settlement (ledger settlements: {settlements})
LanguageData.LW_Settings_BootstrapLedgerTip: When enabled, Living World builds its initial settlement population and resource ledger as the RimWorld world is created.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_DebugLoggingTip: Write Living World bootstrap summaries to the RimWorld log.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_WorldMapSpeedTestTip: When enabled, Living World can raise the real tick rate to the selected multiplier only while the global world map is selected. Paused, normal speed and colony maps are left unchanged.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_WorldWarEnabledTip: When on, NPC factions raid, scout, trade and wage war on each other. Automatically ceded to Rim War when it is active.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_CompatNoneActive: No conflicting mods detected. Living World drives the full NPC world.
LanguageData.LW_MissionMarkerInspect: {faction} {kind}: heading to {target} - arrives in about {days} day(s).
LanguageData.LW_MissionReason_Warband: military action ordered by its faction
LanguageData.LW_InspectThreatLine: Under threat: a warband is inbound - arrives in about {days} day(s).
LanguageData.LW_WorldGenBlurb: Living World tracks every faction settlement as a living ledger of people and resources - they grow, migrate, trade and wage war even when you never see them. World size and population are set by the vanilla planet options above.
LanguageData.LW_WorldGenAdvancedHint: Fine-tuning (settlement sizes, economy, drifters) lives in Options - Mod Settings - Living World.
LanguageData.LW_DrifterArrivalLetterText: {0}, a drifter from beyond the world, has arrived and wishes to join your colony.
LanguageData.LW_FactionRaidLetterText: A hostile faction is attacking with real Living World citizens from its ledger population.
LanguageData.LW_RaidConsequenceLetterText: That raid was staged from {settlement} ({faction}). Of {sent} raiders, {returned} made it home and {lost} were lost - {settlement} is weaker now.
LanguageData.LW_RaidWarningLetterText: {faction} has taken an interest in your colony - {source}. A raid may follow.
LanguageData.LW_RaidWarningSource_Scout: a scout was spotted watching your settlement
LanguageData.LW_RaidWarningSource_Trade: word of your wealth spread through a trader
LanguageData.LW_RaidWarningSource_Rumor: rumors of your holdings are circulating
LanguageData.LW_RaidWarningSource_Survivor: raid survivors reported back on you
LanguageData.LW_RaidWarningSource_DirectVisit: they scouted you during a visit
